requirements.text: generateUlid() in packages/core/src/events/ids.ts is meant to put the creation time in a ULID's first 48 bits, but the ids it generates decode to random times (ulidToTime gives anything from 1970 to the year 10888), so event ids do not sort in creation order. Make generated ULIDs carry the current time in their timestamp prefix, keep setFixedUlidSeed deterministic, and add a test.
